findings.message: Unsupported architecture: hosting/docker-compose.yaml defines 4 application services (app-service, proxy-service, couchdb-service, litellm-service). Deployz runs ONE web process per deployment plus declared background workers.

This app requires environment variables that have no value yet: ATLASSIAN_API_TOKEN, BAMBOOHR_API_KEY, BBAI_LITELLM_KEY, BB_ADMIN_USER_PASSWORD, BUDIBASE_VERSION, and 16 more. Set them in the application's Configuration screen before deploying.
